story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price TCS to move about ±6.9%, roughly 2,401 to 2,757. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 57% of the time.
Options on TCS are priced for moves of about 1.85% a day. That is on the high side for TCS compared with the past year.
Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.6 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Against the past year, that gap is normal for TCS.
Options are priced close to how much TCS has really been moving (about 29.3% a year).

iv.simple: Options on TCS are priced for moves of about 1.85% a day. That is on the high side for TCS compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 29.3%: 73rd percentile of 1 year, 82nd of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are priced close to how much TCS has really been moving (about 29.3% a year).
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -0.4 vol points, 60th percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 63% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Near and far options on TCS are priced about the same: nothing special is expected soon.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.6 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Against the past year, that gap is normal for TCS.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -0.56 vol pts (front month), 66th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: TCS has actually been moving about 1.87% a day this past month: normal for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 29.7% (52nd percentile of the past year), RV5 44.4%, RV63 31.8%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 88th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 2,700 (+5.0% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 2,200 (-14.5%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.66; all-expiry OI PCR at the 58th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +621,900, puts -71,100 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: TCS futures trade 8.0 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 3.5% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +8.0, annualised carry 3.5% (50th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 3.5%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long build-up, Long build-up, Short covering, Long build-up, Short build-up. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price TCS to move about ±6.9%, roughly 2,401 to 2,757. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 57% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 6.89% (forward 2,579.1). Scored on 1,956 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: TCS has used 17% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
Lot size changes from 225 to 250 for the 2027-01-25 contracts (the exchange has already listed them so).
